1. Rent-to-Own Subscription & Ownership Model

Pico POS operates on a Rent-to-Own software licensing model:

  • Payment plans: a monthly recurring plan, or a lump-sum annual plan.
  • 12-month ownership threshold: once you've paid for 12 consecutive months (or the annual equivalent), your subscription converts into a perpetual, royalty-free license.
  • Lifetime access: after reaching that milestone, no further payments are required to run the core POS. Optional future upgrades or cloud add-ons may carry separate fees.
  • Cancellation: if you cancel before completing the 12-month cycle, payments made up to that point are non-refundable and do not carry over toward a partial license.

2. Subscriptions Purchased Through the App Store / Google Play

When you subscribe through the iOS or Android app, your purchase is billed and managed by Apple or Google according to their respective terms. Renewals, cancellations, and refund requests for app-purchased subscriptions are handled through your Apple ID or Google Play account settings, not directly by Himpower Pvt. Ltd.

3. Scope of Service & Hardware Compatibility

The Software facilitates order entry, receipt generation, sales logging, and basic analytics. While we strive to support general POS hardware (thermal receipt printers, tablets, etc.), hardware compatibility depends on device manufacturers, operating system, and browser/OS capabilities — for example, direct Bluetooth printer pairing is only available on Android and desktop browsers; iOS devices print via the standard system print sheet (AirPrint). We do not guarantee uninterrupted interoperability with all third-party devices.

4. Compliance, Taxation & Local Regulations

The Software provides customizable fields for tax rates and identifiers. Himpower Pvt. Ltd. is not a tax advisor or legal auditor. It is your sole responsibility to ensure that the rates, invoice numbers, and reports generated by Pico POS comply with local tax authorities and business regulations in your jurisdiction.
